# GT-ToneMapping Notice

The HDRP custom post process in `Runtime/PostProcessing/GTToneMapping.cs` and
`Shaders/PostProcessing/VLiveKitGTToneMapping.shader` adapts the Gran Turismo /
Uchimura tone mapping curve parameters and shader formula from:
